Front/back have a wide almost symmetric leg spread; input is a narrower asymmetric fashion stance (exact knees/hips are concealed). Side view is comparatively upright with near-level soles, unlike B, but cannot establish true support or collision clearance. Joints: L elbow (25.995,110.937,8.910), L wrist (24.352,89.154,19.366) cm place the hand forward; an exact target wrist/depth cannot be recovered from this image. Only root and four arm bones have nonzero saved pose rotations; legs/spine/head otherwise remain neutral. Photo camera yaw approximately -30 degrees means apparent photograph similarity partly comes from camera. This is not proof of the photographed 3D pose.
